en.hero_title: Your windshield. Repaired quickly and properly.
en.hero_description: Chip repair, windshield replacement, side and rear windows as well as mobile service — Aydin Autoglas takes care of your vehicle glazing in Hildrizhausen and across the Böblingen district.
en.hero_badge1: Chip repair often at no cost to you
en.hero_badge3: Mobile service across the Böblingen district
en.about_title: A family business with real expertise in vehicle glazing
en.about_role: Chip repair, glass replacement & mobile service
en.about_paragraph1: Aydin Autoglas is a family-run business in Hildrizhausen. Led by Recep Aydin and Can Aydin, we personally handle every enquiry — from a small chip repair to a complete windshield replacement.
en.about_paragraph2: We work to manufacturer specifications, settle the costs directly with your insurance company and, on request, offer mobile service at your location throughout the Böblingen district.
en.services_description: From a quick chip repair to a professional glass replacement and mobile service right where you are.
en.process_title: From your enquiry to a repaired windshield
en.process_description: A short message, a clear assessment, a quick appointment — we keep the effort on your side to a minimum.
en.testimonials_description: Family-run, personally reachable, professional installation to manufacturer specifications and straightforward insurance handling — here in Hildrizhausen and mobile across the whole Böblingen district.
en.cta_description: Whether it's a chip, a crack or a full replacement — tell us about the damage and we'll take care of the rest.
en.accreditations.0.title: Professional installation
en.accreditations.0.description: Repair and replacement to manufacturer specifications, including ADAS calibration.
en.accreditations.1.title: Quick appointments
en.accreditations.1.description: Short waiting times, often within the same week.
en.accreditations.2.title: Insurance handling
en.accreditations.2.description: We clarify the cost coverage directly with your insurance company.
en.process_steps.0.title: Enquiry & assessment
en.process_steps.0.description: You describe the damage and we tell you whether a repair is enough or a replacement is needed.
en.process_steps.1.title: Appointment & insurance
en.process_steps.1.description: We arrange an appointment at the workshop or mobile at your place and clarify the cost coverage with your insurer.
en.process_steps.2.title: Repair & handover
en.process_steps.2.description: Professional execution including calibration where required, then we hand your vehicle back ready to drive.

tr.hero_description: Taş çarpması onarımı, ön cam değişimi, yan ve arka camlar ile mobil servis — Aydin Autoglas, Hildrizhausen ve Böblingen bölgesinde aracınızın camlarıyla ilgileniyor.

tr.about_title: Araç camı konusunda uzman bir aile işletmesi

tr.about_paragraph1: Aydin Autoglas, Hildrizhausen'de bulunan aile işletmesi bir firmadır. Recep Aydin ve Can Aydin yönetiminde, küçük bir taş çarpması onarımından komple cam değişimine kadar her talebe bizzat ilgileniyoruz.
tr.about_paragraph2: Üretici talimatlarına uygun çalışıyor, masrafları doğrudan sigortanızla hallediyor ve talep halinde Böblingen bölgesinin tamamında yerinde mobil servis sunuyoruz.

tr.process_description: Kısa bir mesaj, net bir değerlendirme, hızlı bir randevu — size düşen işi minimumda tutuyoruz.
tr.testimonials_description: Aile işletmesi, bizzat ulaşılabilir, üretici talimatlarına uygun profesyonel montaj ve kolay sigorta işlemleri — hem Hildrizhausen'de hem de tüm Böblingen bölgesinde mobil olarak.
tr.cta_description: İster taş çarpması, ister çatlak, ister komple değişim — hasarı bize anlatın, gerisini biz halledelim.
